# Overheard

> Overheard is a free, open-source (MIT) Mac menu bar app that records calls without a bot joining the meeting, transcribes them with speakers and timestamps (on-device or with ElevenLabs in the cloud), summarizes decisions and action items, and makes meetings searchable from Claude Code, Claude Desktop or Codex through an MCP server.

- Platform: Apple Silicon Mac, macOS 14.2 or later (on-device transcription needs macOS 15). No Intel, Windows or Linux.
- Price: free. No account, no subscription. Cloud transcription is billed by ElevenLabs only if you choose it; summaries use the Claude Code or Codex subscription you already have.
- Recording: system audio via Core Audio process taps (no virtual audio driver such as BlackHole), microphone on a separate track. Starts automatically when Google Meet, Microsoft Teams or Slack use the microphone; any other app with one click.
- Transcription: ElevenLabs Scribe (cloud) or Cohere Transcribe running locally on the Mac's GPU with on-device speaker diarization.
- Storage: plain WAV and Markdown files in ~/Meetings, one folder per meeting.
- MCP tools: search_meetings, get_meeting, list_meetings, list_action_items, complete_action_item, bookmark, start_recording, stop_recording.
- Author: Gabriele Spilotri Cavaiola (https://github.com/anonbeat1, https://x.com/Gabbosc). Version 0.3.2, October 2026.
